description: Home advantage for a 2DT sport is RAW GOALS -- the model is additive, there is no link to undo. Applying football's exp() to an additive parameter is the B5 bug. median and lower stay within +/-20 as the gross-error guard (exp() of a realistic ~1.5-goal edge is ~4.5 and stays inside; a B5-shaped 54.6 does not). upper is wider on purpose: the per-team prior is normal(0,10) on each side, so a team with one match (Vidir, Grill 66 karla, 2026-09-05) carries a 95% upper of ~35 that is the model's honest uncertainty, not a units error -- and a cap that rejects it darkens the whole cell. The exact units check remains tests/testthat/test-extract-2dt-home-advantage-units.R.
